claim: QuakeJS is a JavaScript source port of ioquake3 using Emscripten.

support.quote: QuakeJS is a port of [ioquake3](http://www.ioquake3.org) to JavaScript with the help of [Emscripten](http://github.com/kripken/emscripten).

claim: The ioquake3 source lineage includes the Q3 source release. Quake 3 game source is GPLv2; game data is separate.
limit: This is not evidence that every engine dependency or game asset is freely redistributable.

claim: Noclip describes itself as a digital museum of video game levels and documents camera/scene exploration.

support.quote: A digital museum of video game levels

claim: Use noclip as an example of game-level viewing and model-format reverse engineering; these sources do not establish a complete playable reconstruction of each represented game.
limit: This statement does not assert that no game-specific mechanics exist anywhere in noclip.
